raw_signal_observation: DeleteEventDialog sets deleteEventRepeatDescription to selection_contains_repetition when eventIds.size > 1, then immediately overwrites that text on every path with either task_is_repeatable or event_is_repeatable. The multi-selection-specific description therefore cannot survive initialization.
material_claim: The repository exposes a bounded local branch-overwrite defect candidate: a specific multi-selection message is assigned but made unreachable as final dialog text by the following unconditional task/event branch. A narrow conditional fix is locally supportable without asserting any user-comprehension or field outcome.
neta_next_move: Make the message branches mutually exclusive so the multi-selection copy can survive when eventIds.size > 1, and add controls for multi-selection, single task, and single event. Keep the change limited to message selection.
reversal_condition: If a current owner contract shows the generic task/event message is intentionally required even for multi-selection and selection_contains_repetition is dead legacy copy, remove the dead branch instead of restoring it.
baseline_decision: BUILD: fix the overwritten multi-selection description by reordering or making the conditions mutually exclusive, with regression coverage for all three message states.

evidence: Post-freeze issue search found no exact report about the multi-event deletion description being overwritten.
Post-freeze PR search found no repair or maintainer discussion closing this exact message-selection behavior.
adjudication.decision_delta: NO_MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE: both reviewers reached the same narrow BUILD decision; no independent evidence was found to close the exact claim.
adjudication.lesson: The local overwrite remains a strong repository observation but the HOLDOUT case is score-only and supplies no learning or promotion evidence before the wave closes.
